name: Soft Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries no heat and no weight so the blow lands as an odd deadening ache.

name: Voidnumb Touch
description: Touch a limb of an opponent and leave a patch of dead feeling that slows the grip.

name: Blank Hand
description: Hold an empty hand before a small blow of qi and let it fade to nothing on contact.

name: Gap Sense
description: Feel for places in the air where qi should be but is not and learn what hides in them.

name: Null Press
description: Press the emptied palm into the chest of an opponent and leave a hollow ache behind.

name: Hush Palm
description: Lay a palm on the wrist of a caster and quiet the qi running under it for a breath.

name: Tracefree Step
description: Take a single step that makes no sound and leaves no mark of qi on the ground.

name: Soundless Tread
description: Walk on with every footfall swallowed by emptiness so no listener marks the user.

name: Naught Sense
description: Feel the silence round the body and notice any disturbance that breaks it.

name: Silent Strike
description: Hit with a blow whose sound and whose qi are both emptied away before they reach the target.

name: Fade Step
description: Step to the side while the qi of the old position drains away and leaves nothing for a foe to follow.

name: Blank Guard
description: Open a blank space before the chest in which a thin bolt of qi simply fails to exist.

name: Void Plate
description: Raise a flat plate of nothing before the user that a weapon strikes without meeting anything.

name: Dulling Turn
description: Turn a blow aside by taking the force out of it at the moment of contact.

name: Emptied Stance
description: Hold a still stance with the body emptied of intent so no attack finds a mark to aim at.

name: Nil Ward
description: Cast a ward of nothing before an ally to erase a small flame or spark that flies toward them.

name: Void Brace
description: Brace against a heavy push and let the push pass into emptiness beneath the feet.

name: Drained Catch
description: Catch a thrown item in an empty hand and strip the qi from it so it drops dead.

name: Empty Fist
description: Strike with a fist that holds nothing and so cannot be read before it lands.

name: Absence Read
description: Read where the qi of a room is missing to find the shape of what stands in the way.

name: Blank Jab
description: Jab with two fingers that carry no qi at all and so pass any ward set to catch qi.

name: Cancel Touch
description: Touch a small technique in the air and cancel it where it floats.

name: Naught Step
description: Step through a gap that the opponent's own guard has left empty.

name: Hushed Sweep
description: Sweep a leg low and drain the weight from the ground under the opponent's foot.
